ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a fused bicyclic transition-state structure; the left and right six-membered rings share one C-C edge; a C=C double bond is drawn at the lower part of the left ring. Above the structure, one ring carbon is connected to O, and then O is connected to the OH oxygen bearing H; below the structure, one ring carbon is connected to a negatively charged O. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the question requires ignoring arrows and excluding bonds involving hydrogen. Reasoning: According to the specified method, first count the unique C-C bonds in the fused bicyclic carbon skeleton. The two six-membered rings each have 6 edges, 12 in total, but they share 1 C-C edge, so the carbon skeleton contributes 12 - 1 = 11 heavy-atom bonds; the drawn C=C is counted as one bond connection. Then add the non-hydrogen heteroatom bonds: 1 upper ring C-O bond, 1 O-O bond in O-OH, and 1 lower C-O⁻ bond, for a total of 3. Exclude the O-H bond and ignore arrows. Therefore the total is 11 + 3 = 14.

method.method_draft: First count the unique C-C bonds in the fused bicyclic framework: two six-membered rings would contribute 6 + 6 edges, but they share one C-C edge, so the carbon framework contributes 11 heavy-atom bonds, with the drawn C=C counted as one bond connection. Then add the non-hydrogen heteroatom bonds visible in the substituents: the top ring C-O bond, the O-O bond to the OH oxygen, and the lower C-O⁻ bond. Exclude the O-H bond and ignore all arrows. Total = 11 + 3 = 14.

图像描述：图中是一个稠合双环的过渡态结构，左、右两个六元环共享一条 C-C 边；左侧环下部画有一个 C=C 双键。结构上方有一个环碳连接到 O，随后 O 与带 H 的 OH 氧相连；结构下方有一个环碳连接到带负电荷的 O。图中还有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头，并且排除涉及氢的键。
推理：按指定方法，先数稠合双环碳骨架中的唯一 C-C 键。两个六元环各有 6 条边，共 12 条，但它们共享 1 条 C-C 边，所以碳骨架贡献 12 - 1 = 11 个重原子键；其中画出的 C=C 按一个键连接计数。再加上非氢杂原子键：上方环 C-O 键 1 个、O-OH 中的 O-O 键 1 个、下方 C-O⁻ 键 1 个，共 3 个。排除 O-H 键并忽略箭头。因此总数为 11 + 3 = 14。
